# Farsight

> Farsight answers natural-language questions about professional League of Legends (LoL) esports: Worlds, MSI, LCK, LPL, LEC, LCS and other leagues. Each answer is a table with a one-sentence summary and links to its Leaguepedia source pages. The site is free, in French and in English.

A question can be put in the address: `https://askfarsight.com/?q=<question>` (French page) or `https://askfarsight.com/en?q=<question>` (English page). Questions are understood in both languages on either page.

## Pages

- [Farsight (français)](https://askfarsight.com): ask a question in French
- [Farsight (English)](https://askfarsight.com/en): ask a question in English
- [How Farsight works](https://askfarsight.com/en/how-it-works): the four steps behind an answer, the data and its limits
- [Comment Farsight fonctionne](https://askfarsight.com/comment-ca-marche): the same page in French

## Example questions

- [Faker vs Chovy](https://askfarsight.com/en?q=Faker%20vs%20Chovy): head-to-head between two players
- [Azir stats at Worlds 2025](https://askfarsight.com/en?q=Azir%20stats%20at%20Worlds%202025): a champion in a tournament
- [Most banned champions in LCK 2025](https://askfarsight.com/en?q=Most%20banned%20champions%20in%20LCK%202025): a champion ranking

## Data

- [Leaguepedia](https://lol.fandom.com): match results, drafts and game statistics, CC BY-SA 3.0
- Riot Data Dragon: champion, item and rune names and icons
- In-game statistics are missing for the LPL; Farsight says so instead of guessing

## Optional

- [Legal notice and privacy](https://askfarsight.com/en/legal-notice)
- [Mentions légales et confidentialité](https://askfarsight.com/mentions-legales)
